turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Hi! Certainly. A quick recap: with he, she and it we add -s (works), -es after -sh, -ch, -s, -x, -o (watches, goes), and -ies after a consonant + y (studies).

Let's start with a tricky one: My brother ___ (go) to the gym on Fridays. Answer with only the verb.
